title: A pious appearance that deceives
literal_meaning: A cat as a Vaishnava devotee.
explanation: A show of devotion conceals conduct that contradicts it. The target is the mismatch between appearance and action, not believers as a group.
meaning_odia: ବାହାରେ ଧାର୍ମିକ ବେଶ ଓ ଭକ୍ତିର ଦେଖାଣି, ଭିତରେ ତାହାର ବିପରୀତ ଆଚରଣ। ରୂପ ଓ କାମର ଏହି ଅମେଳକୁ ବିରାଡ଼ିର ଉପମାରେ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ କରାଯାଇଛି। କପଟକୁ ଚିହ୍ନିବା ଏଠାରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ, କୌଣସି ଧର୍ମର ସବୁ ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଏକା ଭାବେ ଦେଖିବା ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A fictional official advertises personal virtue while secretly taking unfair benefits. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The exact dictionary spelling ବଇଷମ is preserved. It is given as a figurative synonym under ଭେଖଧାରୀ ବୈଷ୍ଣବ; no animal fable or historical founder is supplied.
